text: Every great cup starts with a conversation.
Meet Brew. Your tea concierge, on WhatsApp.
Got a tea question? Just ask. From the perfect masala chai to the right strength, Brew replies in seconds.
Ordering takes one message. Add your details in a single tap, then pay by UPI or link, right in the chat.
Come back anytime. Brew remembers you: your details, your usual, even how you like your tea.
Then it's fresh from the Nilgiris, straight to your door, with updates along the way.
Meet Brew. Say hi on WhatsApp today.
